script.title: What $50 a month in subscriptions really costs over 30 years
script.hook: What do your subscriptions really cost?

scenes.heading: Fifty dollars
scenes.narration: Fifty dollars a month in subscriptions feels like nothing. Over 30 years, it is a very different number. Let's do the math.
scenes.visual_brief:
#pergunta What do your subscriptions really cost?
Open the loop.

scenes.heading: The yearly bill
scenes.narration: $50 a month is $600 a year. Most people never look at that total.
scenes.visual_brief:
#numero 600 | dollars a year at $50 a month
Annualize it.

scenes.heading: Thirty years
scenes.visual_brief:
#numero 18000 | dollars spent over 30 years
The straight sum.

scenes.heading: The other path
scenes.narration: Now imagine the same $50 a month invested instead. We assume 7% a year, just to do the math. Real returns vary, and you can lose money.
scenes.visual_brief:
#lista $50 a month; 30 years; 7% a year, assumed
Assumptions.

scenes.heading: What it becomes
scenes.narration: After 30 years, it could be about $61,000.
scenes.visual_brief:
#numero 61000 | dollars after 30 years at 7%
The compounding result.

scenes.heading: Spent or invested
scenes.narration: Same $50 a month. Spent, it is $18,000 gone. Invested, about $61,000.
scenes.visual_brief:
#grafico After 30 years, in thousands of dollars | Spent=18; Invested=61
Side by side.

scenes.heading: Why the gap
scenes.narration: Growth earns growth. In the later years, most of the increase comes from returns on returns, not from your deposits.
scenes.visual_brief:
#causa $50 goes in every month => It earns returns => The returns earn returns too
Compounding.

scenes.heading: Not about cutting fun
scenes.narration: This is not about cancelling everything you enjoy. It is about the subscriptions you forgot you have.

scenes.heading: A ten minute audit
scenes.narration: Open your bank or card app, search for recurring charges, and cancel the ones you did not use last month. This is math, not financial advice.
scenes.visual_brief:
#passos Search your statement for recurring charges; Mark what you did not use last month; Cancel those today
Action.

claims.text: $50 a month is $600 a year and $18,000 over 30 years. Calculo proprio.
$50 a month invested for 30 years at 7% a year, compounded monthly, ends near $61,000 ($60,999). Calculo proprio.
